title: BetterPVE
description: BetterPVE improves vanilla Minecraft PvE with progression tasks, cave encounters, stronger mobs, useful automation blocks, PvE currency, rewards, and a built-in shop.
body:
# BetterPVE

BetterPVE is a PvE-focused Minecraft mod that makes survival combat, cave exploration, mining, and progression feel more rewarding without turning the game into a completely different experience.

The mod adds a full progression system with tasks, rewards, PvE currency, cave encounters, stronger underground mobs, useful utility blocks, and an in-game shop. It is made for players who want vanilla survival to have more long-term goals and more reasons to explore, fight, mine, and build automation.

## Features

### Progression System

BetterPVE adds a large task-based progression system split into multiple categories:

* Combat
* Mining
* Automation
* Exploration
* Shop

Complete tasks, claim rewards, and slowly build up your PvE progression while playing normal survival.

### PvE Currency

The mod adds PvE Coins, which can be earned through tasks and PvE activities. Coins can be used in the built-in shop to buy useful survival items.

### In-Game Shop

Open the BetterPVE menu and spend your PvE Coins on useful items and resources. The shop is designed to support survival progression without completely replacing normal gameplay.

### Cave Encounters

Instead of adding huge custom dungeons, BetterPVE focuses on natural cave encounters. While exploring underground, players can run into stronger PvE mobs that make caves more dangerous and more rewarding.

### Cave Difficulty Scaling

Mobs become more dangerous deeper underground. This makes deep mining and cave exploration feel more intense, especially in lower world heights.

### Utility Blocks

BetterPVE adds several useful blocks for survival and automation:

* Mob Detector
* Spawn Ward
* Block Damager
* Material Exchanger
* Reinforced Hopper
* Chunk Loaders
* Vertical Wooden Slabs

These blocks are designed to improve PvE survival, base defense, resource handling, and building.

### Block Damager

The Block Damager is a special utility block that can attack nearby mobs using a sword placed inside it. It can store experience and works as a useful PvE automation block.

### Vertical Slabs

BetterPVE also adds vertical wooden slabs for better building options while keeping the vanilla style.

## How to Open the Menu

Press **K** to open the BetterPVE progression and shop menu.

## Why BetterPVE?

Vanilla Minecraft PvE can become repetitive after some time. BetterPVE gives players more goals, more rewards, stronger cave threats, and useful survival tools while keeping the core vanilla feeling.

This mod is best for survival players who want:

* more PvE progression;
* more reasons to explore caves;
* more useful rewards;
* more combat goals;
* better survival automation;
* a vanilla-friendly experience.
